_meta.description: Presentation-grade loyalty-missions demo (seed-missions-demo.mjs). Stands on the sales-rep demo: buyer/org keys are DEMO_CONTACTS / DEMO_ORGS in sales-rep-demo-specs.mjs. No AGENT-TEST string, no GUID, no SKU, no currency code — products are discovered per org family, the goal currency is the store's default, read live.

fields.missions[].goal: OrderValueGoal {value} | OrderCountGoal {count} | PerSkuGoal {all, items[{slot, quantity}]} — a PerSku slot is a product picked from featuredFrom's family
fields.missions[].window: {startInDays, endInDays} relative to seed time; endInDays null = open-ended
fields.missions[].banner: order-value | order-count | per-sku — the committed artwork under test-data/uploads/
fields.progressOrders[]: real orders placed BY the buyer after the missions exist; each contributes to every active mission at once (count +1, value +order total, PerSku units of its slot products)
fields.progressOrders[].lines[]: {qty, price} from the buyer's org family, or {slot, qty, price} for a featured product
fields.expect: the progress each (buyer, mission) must reach — DERIVED by the spec module from the orders and checked against it; listed here so a reviewer reads the story without running code
